_note: The base is the UNCONDITIONAL half of his Famorian case -- a race like any other. The evokes are the conditional half; only fifteen of them change a number, and those fifteen are applied by module/famorian-rules.mjs. The rest are described abilities, listed and not applied, as racial abilities already are.

breeds.when: Always On. One or more animal packages.

fins.label: Fins/Flippers/Flukes
fins.detail: Increases swimming speed and the skill by 20%.

extra_insect_legs.label: Extra Insect Legs
extra_insect_legs.detail: Gain Scurry and insect legs, etc.

air_jets.label: Air Jets
air_jets.detail: x2 Swim Speed for 10 sec, 10 min to replinish.

ambidextrous.label: Ambidextrous
ambidextrous.detail: 10 seconds of time, both hands, no penalties.

antlers.label: Antlers
antlers.detail: 5 Sec, 4 min, 1d4 piercing damage per antler, 1d4 antlers per Title

barbed_tail.label: Barbed Tail
barbed_tail.detail: 5 sec, 4 min, 2d6+2 dam, 50% break off in pierced wound, 1d6+1 dam when removed.

bioluminescence.label: Bioluminescence
bioluminescence.detail: Produces low light from a body area.

claws_raking.label: Claws,Raking
claws_raking.detail: Gives second raking claw attack when grabbled, as other claws but +1 per die.

desert_endurance.label: Desert Endurance
desert_endurance.detail: delays need to drink or eat for up to one week.

disease_bearing.label: Disease Bearing
disease_bearing.detail: Carries a random or GM selected disease.

diving_aerial.label: Diving, Aerial
diving_aerial.detail: No AGL save needed to avoid crashing from dives.

echo_location.label: Echo Location
echo_location.detail: Locate objects within 2 feet per INT.

enhanced_taste.label: Enhanced Taste
enhanced_taste.detail: Identify poisons or impurities with a single drop/morsel.

exceptional_sight.label: Exceptional Sight
exceptional_sight.detail: Vision range x2, Missile Weapons +1 to Hit.

extra_limbs_arms.label: Extra Limbs, Arms
extra_limbs_arms.detail: Gains pair of extra arms, forearms and hands/paws/pads, etc.

extra_torsos_segments.label: Extra Torsos, Segments
extra_torsos_segments.detail: gains additional segments like a worm or snake.

torsos_fused.label: Torsos/Head Fused
torsos_fused.detail: Torsos or head/torso fuse together, like a spider.

farsight.label: Farsight
farsight.detail: Vison range x3, Missile Weapons +2 to Hit., +25% Surprise, -25% to be surprised.

food_conserve.label: Food Conservation
food_conserve.detail: Half food intake, can go without twice as long.

gas_bag.label: Gas Bladder/Bag
gas_bag.detail: Holds lighter than air gasses, maintains neutral buoyancy in air.

glide_wings.label: Wings, Glide
glide_wings.detail: Membranous tissue covering arm to thigh. Allows slow descent glide.

hibernation.label: Hibernation
hibernation.detail: Sleep for 1 month per Title. Wake ravenous, needing to ingest double food quantities for 1 day per week of hibernation. Physical attributes temporarily reduced by 1 per month of hibernation, returning by 1 per week after awakening. 2$ of body weight is lost per month of hibernation and returns at 2% per week.

horns.label: Horns
horns.detail: 5 Sec, 4 min, 1d4 piercing damage per horn, no more than 1d4 horns per Title.

hypnotic_gaze.label: Hypnotic Gaze
hypnotic_gaze.detail: Control Resistance or victim remains motionless until the being breaks contact or attacks.

ink_spray.label: Ink Spray
ink_spray.detail: Emits underwater ink spray, perception needed to find being. 10+ seconds after double perception to find being. Usage once per minute per Title.

inflation.label: Inflation
inflation.detail: Increases the size of a specific body area by 20%, +20% to Intimidation, -2 to damage taken to that area while inflated.

insect_arms.label: Insect Limbs
insect_arms.detail: extra pair of arms, forearms and claw-like hands.

instinct_food.label: Instinct,Food
instinct_food.detail: Sense distance & direction of nearest food. Chance is Rating 13 vs. INT. Range 1 mile per Title.

instinct_life.label: Instinct,Life
instinct_life.detail: Sense distance & direction of nearest life. Chance is Rating 12 vs. INT. Range 1 mile per Title.

instinct_social.label: Instinct,Social
instinct_social.detail: Sense nearest animal or group matching the evoke animal form. Chance is Rating 15 vs. INT. Range 1 mile per Title.

instinct_water.label: Instinct,Water
instinct_water.detail: Sense distance & direction of nearest water. Chance is Rating 12 vs. INT. Range 1 mile per Title.

metabolic_control_low.label: Metabolic Control,Low
metabolic_control_low.detail: Shift between slow, normal and high metabolism at will.

metabolic_control_high.label: Metabolic Control,High
metabolic_control_high.detail: Shift between any metabolism rate at will.

metabolic_stage_low.label: Metabolic Control,Two-Stage Low
metabolic_stage_low.detail: Shift between normal metabolism and very slow metabolism.

metabolic_stage_high.label: Metabolic Control,Two-Stage High
metabolic_stage_high.detail: Shift between normal metabolism and very high metabolism.

metabolism_very_slow.label: Metabolism,Very Slow
metabolism_very_slow.detail: -50% food intake/+20% weight,+2 Initiative, movement is 50%.

musk_spray.label: Musk Spray
musk_spray.detail: VIT save once per 10 sec or be incapacitated.

night_vision.label: Night Vision
night_vision.detail: Near darkness vision. Bright light: blinds 1d6+1 sec. -2 to hit/+1 initiative after.

padded_feet.label: Padded Feet
padded_feet.detail: Movement on shifting/loose/slick surfaces is normal.

patterned_fur.label: Patterned Fur
patterned_fur.detail: +10% to Blend, +5% to Move Unseen in matching terrain.

pincers_mandibles.label: Pincers/Mandibles
pincers_mandibles.detail: 7 sec/5 min: 5d6 crushing damage: smaller creatures must win contest of STR to escape.

poison_spit.label: Poisonous Spit
poison_spit.detail: Poison Type=Title or less, half dagger range.

prehensile_tail.label: Prehensile Tail
prehensile_tail.detail: Can grasp/lift objects or hold the body weight of the being.

quiet_flier.label: Silent Flight
quiet_flier.detail: at jogging speeds or less. +20% to surprise attack.

quills.label: Quills
quills.detail: 1+ areas have quills, 1d4 quills grown per Title, 3d4 damage per quill, as dagger range/speed.

regen_natural.label: Regeneration,Natural
regen_natural.detail: limbs regrow at healing rate, vitals kill, acid/fire stop regrowth.

regen_budding.label: Regeneration,Budding
regen_budding.detail: limbs regrow at healing rate, vitals kill, acid/fire stop regrowth. Amputated limbs regrow into half-sized beings.

roar_scream.label: Roar/Scream
roar_scream.detail: 10 INT or less flee in panic.

shocking_sting.label: Shocking Sting
shocking_sting.detail: immune to electricity, 1 body area per 2 titles can shock for 1d8 electricity per 2 titles.

spikes.label: Spikes
spikes.detail: 5 sec, 4 min, 1d4 piercing damage per spike, no more than 1d4 spikes per Title.

social_bonding.label: Social Bonding
social_bonding.detail: Call nearest animal or group matching evoke type.

sticky_tongue.label: Sticky Tongue
sticky_tongue.detail: 3 sec, extends 3x being's height, STR save to escape.

tail_slap.label: Tail Slap
tail_slap.detail: Gains Tail 1/2 End body area. 3 sec/2 min: 3d4 smashing damage.

tusks.label: Tusks
tusks.detail: 5 sec, 4 min, 1d4 piercing damage per tusk, no more than 1d4 tusks per Title.

well_tanned.label: Web Weaving
well_tanned.detail: Strong webs are web strength of being's END, and Hide equal to the being's VIT. Sticky webs are 1/2 END but cause entanglement: STR Save at -50% to escape. Both types shoot to dagger range.

wood_cutting.label: Wood Cutting
wood_cutting.detail: Cuts up to 1 inch of wood or weaker material per minute.
